name: Mysterious Five
description: The Mysterious Five was a youth street gang from the East Bronx, active in the 1940s. They were rivals of another local gang, the Noble Dukes. The two groups were involved in a shooting on November 16, 1946, at 828 Dawson Street in the Bronx, which was reported in the PM newspaper on November 18, 1946.

sources.title: The Bronx Noble Dukes and the Mysterious Five | New York City Fighting Gangs
